content.title: About
content.content: Watermelon juice 100% is a completely natural beverage made from ripe watermelon without added sugar, preservatives, or flavorings. It has a bright red color, sweet taste, and the refreshing aroma characteristic of fresh watermelon.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Watermelon is composed of more than 90% water, making the juice an excellent thirst quencher.
It contains lycopene, a powerful antioxidant that gives the juice its characteristic red hue.
Watermelon juice is often used in culinary applications such as punches, smoothies, and cocktails.
The natural sweetness of watermelon juice makes it a good alternative to sugary soft drinks.
In traditional medicine, watermelon juice is considered helpful for digestion and lowering body temperature.

items.title: Rich in vitamin C
items.content: Vitamin C supports the immune system and aids collagen synthesis, important for skin and blood vessels.

items.title: Contains lycopene
items.content: Lycopene has antioxidant properties and may help protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: High water content helps maintain the body’s fluid balance, especially in hot weather.

items.title: Low in calories
items.content: Watermelon juice is low in calories, making it a suitable drink for weight management.

items.title: Supports cardiovascular health
items.content: Potassium in the juice contributes to normal blood pressure and heart function.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Although no sugar is added, natural sugars may be a concern for people with diabetes.

items.title: Watermelon allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to watermelon or its juice.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: The juice can be slightly acidic, which might cause discomfort for those with high stomach acidity.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Drink the juice chilled as a refreshing beverage, add it to smoothies, cocktails, or use it as a base for fruit punches. It can also be drizzled over fruit salads to enhance flavor.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the juice in the refrigerator at 0 °C to 4 °C in a sealed container. Once opened, consume within 3–5 days. Discard if the smell or taste changes.
